Thought id write my sons experience in the caption as its easier & to spread some awareness! Hate having to post these photos but hoping it helps anyone going through the same. Saturday morning 4am I took my son hospital as he had temp/was not himself/literally would not sleep, constant dribbling.  They looked in his throat & told me he has “tonsillitis” prescribed him with penicillin. His face began to get this terrible rash which you see in the pictures, likewise with his body although his face was alot worst. I began to suspect & google so many different things. Monday morning i took him doctors for them to tell me two different things & werent even sure themselves. Later that night which was the 3rd day of him being on antibiotics i chose to stop giving them as i didnt know if the rash on his body was an allergic reaction so i decided to take him A&E again the following morning, (yesterday) the lady that checks temp at the beginning before being seen said “HFMD” (hand, foot & mouth) he was then put in his own room & was seen for them to then proceed and tell me he has impetigo & a “viral rash” on his body. They changed his antibiotics for his skin infection and also prescribed me a cream for his face. I then put two & two together & suspect he didnt have “tonsillitis” he clearly had STREP A as impetigo is caused by strep A! He also has a rash all over his body. All these trips and they never done any swabs in his mouth/throat especially with whats going on. Waiting hours in A&E for them to then rush him being seen & not doing proper tests/observations. He was seen for less than 10 minutes after waiting hours! Its ridiculous. Overall he is back to himself which is the main thing, just in the process of getting rid of his impetigo now! ⭐️Sore Throats, Snuffles & Sneezes⭐️ Who else makes a gorgeous fresh juice bursting with goodies whenever you or your kids are going down with a sore throat, sniffle or sneeze? Fresh juices have always been a trusty winner in my household, which you will learn all about in my Little Hero stories in The Good Stuff.  And just this week it’s helped us all nip a winter lurgy in the bud before it took hold - maybe we were just lucky?  Fresh juices are packed with Vitamin A & C as well as polyphenols to nourish the immune system. I always add a big chunk of fresh ginger root which has natural antibacterial and antiviral properties and gives it a lovely zing.  I don’t put the lemon through the juicer as it makes the juice a bit bitter, so just squeeze in the juice and stir in at the end. And you really don’t need a fancy juicer, I’ve had mine for over a decade and it cost less than £100.  Kids love these juices too and any leftovers you can freeze into soothing ice lollies.  They don’t give a sugar hit as much as shop bought juices as they retain some fibre, especially if you include plenty of carrot or other veg like cucumber, celery or kale.  My current favourite, which makes a big juice for 3 people (but could stretch to 4/5 people) is a combo of: 1 x 🍊 4 x 🍎 4 x 🥕 1 x 🍋 ➕Thumb size knob of ginger  What do you love adding to your juices? ⭐️Has Your Child Developed Tics or Twitches since Strep A?⭐️ Even though tics are normally quite common in children, there has been an upsurge of kids with tics & involuntary repetitive movements such as eye blinking, throat clearing, shoulder shrugging or blurting out unusual sounds.  Historically these have been described as "nervous tics" & can be a physical manifestation of underlying anxiety.  However these tics & twitches can also be the soft signs of a misdirected immune system - as we also have immune cells in our brain. This means that infections can lead to inflammation affecting the neurological system.  Streptococcus bacteria (Strep A, Strep Throat, Tonsillitis, Scarlet Fever) is well known to trigger an autoimmune inflammatory reaction to the brain's basal ganglia leading to the onset of tics, anxiety & OCD behaviours, as well as bed wetting & a decline in school work. When full blown this is known as PANDAS (Paediatric Autoimmune Neuropsychiatric Disorder Associated with Streptococcus.  However often the tics and twitches come along just by themselves and luckily do resolve over time. However they can be upsetting to witness and since my son was bullied for having tics, I know how tough it can be for the kids too!  Nutrients that can often help to reduce tics & twitches are Magnesium that helps to regulate our inner electrical impulses and Theanine (the calming stuff in green tea) - so these would be my first port of call!  If they are really struggling and their character has changed since having a strep infection then our NatureDoc team work alongside paediatricians, psychiatrists & neurologists to find a truly integrated approach to help reboot these kids' immune systems & restore them back to their vibrant care-free selves again. This Is Why You Shouldn’t Have Your Tonsils Out Unless You Really Need It #infection  Having your tonsils removed, also known as a tonsillectomy, can be a beneficial medical procedure in certain situations. This surgery is typically recommended when individuals experience recurring or severe issues related to their tonsils. Here are some reasons why someone might consider having their tonsils removed: Recurrent Tonsillitis: Frequent and severe episodes of tonsillitis, which can cause throat pain, fever, and difficulty swallowing, may necessitate tonsil removal. Chronic Sore Throat: If persistent sore throats are impacting your quality of life, removing the tonsils might offer relief. Breathing Problems: Enlarged tonsils can obstruct the airway, leading to breathing difficulties, especially during sleep. Sleep Apnea: Tonsillectomy can be part of the treatment plan for obstructive sleep apnea, a condition characterized by interrupted breathing during sleep. Snoring: Loud snoring due to enlarged tonsils can disrupt your sleep and that of those around you. Frequent Strep Throat: Recurrent strep throat infections may prompt the removal of tonsils to prevent further complications. Peritonsillar Abscess: In some cases, a painful abscess around the tonsils may require surgical drainage and subsequent tonsillectomy. Difficulty Swallowing: Enlarged tonsils can make swallowing uncomfortable or challenging. Tonsil Stones: Chronic tonsil stones, which are calcified debris in the tonsil crypts, can be a source of discomfort and bad breath. Cancer Concerns: In rare cases, if there are suspicions of cancerous growth in the tonsils, removal may be recommended for diagnostic and treatment purposes. Remember, the decision to have a tonsillectomy should be made in consultation with a medical professional who can assess your specific condition and needs. It's important to weigh the potential benefits against the risks and recovery process associated with this surgery. #Tonsillectomy #Health #Surgery #ThroatHealth #MedicalProcedure #Tonsillitis #SleepApnea #Snoring #StrepThroat #BreathingProblems #Healthcare #ChronicSoreThroat #QualityOfLife #ENT #TonsilStones #Abscess #CancerConcerns #Recovery #Consultation #MedicalAdvice #fyp #fypシ #medicine #interesting #healthcare

דלקת גרון סטרפטוקוקלית (GAS), היא זיהום הנגרם על ידי החיידק Streptococcus pyogenes. התסמינים כוללים כאב גרון, קושי בבליעה, חום, כאבי ראש, ואולי גם פריחה. הסימנים הפיזיים כוללים שקדים אדומים ונפוחים, לפעמים עם כתמים לבנים או פסים של מוגלה, כתמים אדומים זעירים באזור בחלק האחורי של גג הפה, ובלוטות לימפה נפוחות ורכות בצוואר. ישנם מספר סיבוכים אפשריים כמו מורסות פריטונסילריות ועד לקדחת שגרונית חריפה, שעלולה להוביל לפגיעה לבבית. קדחת שגרונית חריפה (ARF) היא סיבוך רציני של דלקת גרון סטרפטוקוקלית (GAS). ARF יכולה להתפתח שבועיים עד ארבעה שבועות לאחר הדלקת, במיוחד במקרים בהם הזיהום לא טופל כראוי באנטיביוטיקה. זוהי מחלה דלקתית שעלולה להשפיע על הלב, המפרקים, העור והמוח. התוצאה החמורה ביותר של ARF היא מחלת לב ראומטית, שעלולה לגרום לנזק קבוע למסתמי הלב ולהוביל לאי ספיקת לב ולסיבוכים קרדיווסקולריים אחרים. מניעת ARF היא סיבה מרכזית לטיפול מהיר ומתאים בדלקת גרון עם אנטיביוטיקה כמו פניצילין. הטיפול כולל אנטיביוטיקה, כאשר פניצילין הוא הבחירה הראשונה, וזאת כדי למנוע את הסיבוכים ולנהל את התסמינים. ניתן להשיג הקלה בכאב עם אקמול או NSAIDs. טיפול מהיר חיוני כדי להפחית את הסיכון לסיבוכים ולספק הקלה בתסמינים. #רפואה #רפואה_עם_עידן #כאביגרון #דלקת #דלקתגרון #סטרפטוקוק #acuterheumaticfever #groupastrep #strepthroat #ביתחולים #ניתוח
